candidates.explanation: updateByHash ignores conditions.hash. The UPDATE filters only on { id }, so any hash matches. A stale refresh token (old hash) still finds the session, overwrites the hash and is accepted again. The document (Mongo) repository filters on hash correctly, so only the relational one is broken.

fix.description: Include the hash in the update's where clause so rotation only succeeds when the presented hash matches the stored one: update({ id: Number(conditions.id), hash: conditions.hash }, { hash: payload.hash }). Return null if nothing was affected. The findOne afterwards can stay as it is.
